I honestly cannot recommend Aonang Medical Clinic highly enough. During our stay in Krabi, my partner unfortunately became seriously unwell with food poisoning, and after reading the clinic’s outstanding reviews, I decided to take him there — and every one of those reviews proved to be fully deserved.

From the moment we arrived, the team demonstrated exceptional professionalism, efficiency, and compassion. The nursing staff welcomed us warmly, triaged my partner promptly and appropriately, and ensured he was comfortable resting in a ward while waiting for the doctor. Dr. Suphakris Tanmuk arrived within the hour, and as a doctor myself, I can confidently say that the standard of clinical expertise and patient care we experienced was truly excellent.

The appropriate diagnostic tests were performed immediately, treatment was started without delay, and my partner was admitted that same morning to a private room where I was also able to stay with him. Having that level of comfort and reassurance while abroad meant so much to us. Throughout his stay, the nurses were attentive, kind, and incredibly diligent — regularly monitoring his observations, administering medication, and making sure he was comfortable at all times.

Dr. Suphakris personally reviewed him again later that afternoon and the following day prior to discharge, and every aspect of the care was impeccable. I would also like to give special thanks to the administrative staff, who liaised directly with our insurance company throughout the process, allowing me to focus entirely on supporting my partner during his recovery.

I genuinely don’t think I have ever seen someone recover from a fever and bacterial gastroenteritis so quickly. Upon discharge, the clinic also provided all of the necessary medications clearly labelled, and the nurse took the time to carefully explain how and when each medication should be taken, which we greatly appreciated. They even kindly arranged transportation back to our hotel, another thoughtful gesture during what could have been a stressful experience.

Thank you to everyone at Aonang Medical Clinic for turning what could have been a frightening experience abroad into one that felt calm, safe, and genuinely caring. We will always be incredibly grateful for the outstanding care you provided.

My wife Patrícia was admitted for one night at this clinic, and we had an excellent experience. The service was attentive, professional, and very compassionate. The entire team was kind, caring, and highly competent, giving us confidence every step of the way.
We sincerely thank each staff member for their dedication and kindness. May God continue to bless and guide the work of all of you. Thank you very much! 🙏💛

I visited this clinic in Krabi for wound infection, the staff is so polite, and explained what happened and how to treat it. Wouldnt hesitate to come back for a medical issue, english speaking medical staff, professional facilities, insurance claim assistance and  convenient location for tourists.Highly recommend!

Amazing experience, was in and out within an hour after having a consultation, blood test (results in 5 minutes), iv antibiotics, pain relief, anti inflammatory injections and oral antibiotics and pain relief to take away. The staff were so friendly, explained everything clearly and made the experience so stress free.

I’ll start with the positives:
The place is very well organized—at the beginning they take your details and have you fill out a questionnaire.
The doctor was professional, caring, and attentive.
Everything moved very quickly—we didn’t have to wait or experience delays.

That said:
They don’t accept PassportCard (although my insurance reimbursed me in the end).
The costs for the examination and medications are quite high (I’ve visited hospitals and clinics in Panama and Mexico, and this was more expensive).

I had a severe stomach infection, and the total cost—including consultation, IV fluids, medications, blood tests, and other related treatments—was around 5,500 baht (almost $200).

Overall, if it’s urgent, it’s worth the money—it’s your trip, and they do work efficiently. Just be prepared for the cost.

I visited this clinic because I was suffering from food poisoning and resulting dehydration. Upon arrival, I received prompt and professional care. I had to stay overnight, and the doctor and nurses provided excellent care throughout my stay. Furthermore, the room I stayed in was very clean and well-equipped.

The staff was also very helpful in arranging expenses in advance with my travel and health insurance. All expenses were reimbursed.

Within 24 hours I had improved greatly due to the good care and medication I had received!

The clinic refused to share prescriptions for medicines and said we had to buy the medicines there. They said there’s no prescription system in Thailand. The medicines seemed a bit excessive for the symptoms we were facing. We had a talk with our doctor contacts back home and they gave a different course of action and we decided to stick to it. In India some pharmacies don’t give antibiotics without prescriptions but a pharmacy literally 50 meters from this clinic gave us the antibiotics without asking for a prescription or passport. I’m not sure if this really is the system in Thailand to not give prescriptions for medicines so I’m not going to sound too negative about this. However, when we decided to pay only the OPD fees and refused the medicine, the doctor got really mad at us and told us not to waste money and talk to doctors back home and buy at pharmacy instead of consulting in hospital. Valid advice in retrospec but I wasn’t aware I’d be robbed like this. I’m adding an extra star because I had left my wallet at the clinic and they had kept it safely for me. Overall highly dissatisfied with the service. Please don’t waste your time and money here.

Edit: Response: I don’t know how accurate this is but perplexity clearly mentions that a complete medical report mentions the medicines required. The clinic refusing to do so is clearly a massive red flag. No clinic can force me to buy medicines which this clinic didn’t but also didn’t mention the medicines required in the medical report which it should have. If the clinic refuses to dispute this fact I can upload my medical report here to disprove this immediately. Also, nice gaslighting attempt to ignore the clearly inappropriate behaviour by the doctor who was clearly acting out of line and had no business talking to us like that. I’m taking my extra star back since this clinic refuses to take any accountability whatsoever which is a shame.
